name: Daily 12 minutes
note: The everyday session: wake the voice, settle the key, then the real work.

blocks.label: Settle in
blocks.note: Sing along with the drone, then sing back what you hear.

blocks.label: Warm up in one key
blocks.note: One key, so do settles in your ear.

blocks.label: Main block
blocks.note: Your ladder step, note names hidden. This is the one that counts.

blocks.label: Reverse it
blocks.note: Name to sound - the direction everyone neglects.
